description: This file defines the static class RequestContext in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which manages request-specific context data such as reentrancy IDs and arbitrary key-value pairs, propagating information across Orleans client and grain boundaries.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: A static class that manages request-specific context data, including reentrancy IDs and arbitrary key-value pairs, with support for propagation across Orleans client and grain boundaries.

classes.name: RequestContext.ContextProperties
classes.description: An internal struct holding the dictionary of context values and a property indicating if it is default.

classes.name: RequestContext.ReentrancySection
classes.description: A struct implementing IDisposable that manages the scope of reentrancy state within a request, updating the ReentrancyId accordingly.

methods.name: ReentrancyId
methods.description: Property to get or set the current reentrancy GUID in the request context.

methods.name: AllowCallChainReentrancy
methods.description: Enables reentrancy for subsequent calls within the request context, returning a disposable scope.

methods.name: SuppressCallChainReentrancy
methods.description: Suppresses reentrancy for subsequent calls within the request context, returning a disposable scope.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key from the request context.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets or updates a key-value pair in the request context.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the request context.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the current request context.
